From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sara Gupta <sara.gupta@orlix.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Revenue proofing: deal cleanse for Orlix Analytics

Team — quick reminder ahead of Friday's close. Finance needs a clean commit set for Orlix Analytics so we can include the right ARR in the June book. Please do a focused cleanse on the deals below and reply with the corrected export (CSV) by EOD Thursday, June 17.

Action items for each open opportunity in HubSpot: 
- Confirm amount (USD) matches signed docs or latest commitment email
- Map correct product/SKU code (use the SKU matrix linked in Drive)
- Confirm next step and expected close date (one-line)
- Set probability that reflects current rep confidence (no guesses; use 50/70/85/95 as anchors)

High-impact rows (please prioritize):
- ORLX-298 
- ORLX-301 
- ORLX-314

I will escalate any outstanding items to CS/sales leadership on Friday morning if we don't have the CSV. Copying Sara to keep Orlix procurement in the loop.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Thanks Marcus — on it. Two quick clarifying Qs before I scrub: 
1) For ORLX-301 there are two line items (Core + VectorSearch). Do you want a single aggregated ARR row or separate SKUs per product?
2) For ORLX-314 the rep flagged a pending PO (procurement@orlix.ai). Do we treat that as "commit" or "pending" for probability mapping?

Plan: I'll pull a raw export today, apply the SKU mapping, and attach a corrected CSV by EOD Thursday.

—Ben

Attachments: 20270616-ORLIX-sku-amount-fix.csv (text/csv)

Attached is the cleaned export — I reconciled the three focused rows and a few follow-ons. Summary of key changes (inline):

- ORLX-298: Amount adjusted from 42,000 to 45,000 (reconciled to signed addendum dated 2027-05-20). SKU: CORE-STD retained. Probability set to 85%. Next step: Docs signed; Finance to invoice 07/01.
- ORLX-301: Split into two SKUs per Marcus' note: CORE-ENTR (30,000) + VSEARCH-CPU (12,000). Previously listed as aggregated 42,000. Probabilities set to 70% (Core) and 50% (VectorSearch pending infra call). Next step: Schedule infra sync w/Orlix (rep note).
- ORLX-314: Marked as Pending PO; rep reports procurement is reviewing PO. I set amount to 18,000 but left probability at 50% per your guidance.

I also normalized currency fields and removed an accidental duplicate row for ORLX-289. CSV includes a comment column with linkbacks to the source doc where available.

Please confirm acceptance of these changes or flag anything you want reverted before I push updates to HubSpot.

Attachments: 20270616-ORLIX-sku-amount-fix.csv

—Ben

Thanks Ben — this is mostly good. I accept the split for ORLX-301 and the duplicate removal. One exception: ORLX-298 should remain at 45,000 but probability should be 95% (legal confirmed MA executed). Please update that single row to 95% and add a one-line next-step: "Invoice run 07/01; payment terms net 30".

After you make that small edit, update HubSpot and paste the public HubSpot export link in this thread. I will sign off for finance once I see the HubSpot timestamp and the CSV export.

If you need me to loop sales leadership for verbal confirmation I can do that but prefer not to unless necessary.

—Marcus
